title: Spire and Oath
author: Ansel Halloran
blurb: Paloma Nakamura, a debt-bound temple scribe, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the long winter finishes falling.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
